name: upload-button
title: Upload button
description: A button that opens the file chooser, also takes drops and pastes, and hands you validated files, with progress on the button itself and a cancel while it uploads.
docs: You run the upload: pass state and progress back in. onFiles gets the accepted files and the rejected ones, each with a code and a reason in words (labels.accept replaces the words for what is accepted); show those wherever suits you, or hand the list to File Dropzone.
